newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM Q3, Q4 EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM Q3, Q4 EPS view up.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she raised her fiscal third quarter earnings estimate for Archer Daniels Midland Co to $0.40 a share from $0.35 and her fourth quarter estimate to $0.42 from $0.37. However, her full year estimate remains $1.50 a share, compared with $1.27 a year ago.
-- On Thursday, ADM reported second-quarter net earnings of $0.35 a share, below the consensus estimate of $0.40 and Dain's estimate of $0.45. A year ago, it earned $0.41 a share.
-- ADM shares Friday morning were down 1/8 at 21-3/4.

-- "Grain costs have been falling, but ADM still held considerable inventory in the second quarter at higher prices, which means that margin improvement wasn't as great as analysts expected," Wittenburg wrote in a report. "The company also cited higher energy costs."

-- Wittenburg said she left annual estimates the same, while adjusting quartering estimates, in part because of ADM's planned purchase of a cocoa business. "That acquisition is expected to close sometime in the current quarter," she said. "Annual sales for the cococa business are roughly $800 million."
-- Looking ahead, she said the "biggest worry is ADM's high fructose corn syrup business."

-- "Corn prices are down, so ADM's costs are down, but pricing negotiations are still underway," Wittenburg said. "Given the overcapacity that continues to exist in the industry, and given established players' tendency to make it rough for new players to enter, pricing could also come down such that margins are no better than last year."
